scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:workspace: pnpm run build:generated && pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:api && pnpm --filter @workspace/ai-platform run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:openapi && pnpm run verify:types
scripts.clean:workspace: pnpm run clean:generated && rm -rf artifacts/api-server/dist artifacts/ai-platform/dist artifacts/mockup-sandbox/dist
scripts.rebuild:all: pnpm run clean:workspace && pnpm run build:workspace && pnpm run verify
